title: We burned 11.7bn tokens to find the best cyber AI model | GLM5.3 and DeepSeek are now frontier
summary: We burned 11.7bn tokens to find the best cyber AI model | GLM5.3 and DeepSeek are now frontier Aikido Security
body: We burned 11.7bn tokens to find the best cyber AI model | GLM5.3 and DeepSeek are now frontier Aikido Security
summaryZh: Aikido Security通过消耗117亿Token对多款网络安全AI模型进行评测，结果显示GLM5.3和DeepSeek等模型已跻身前沿梯队，为大模型在专业垂直领域的性能评估提供了实用数据。原始信息显示：We burned 11.7bn tokens to find the best cyber AI model | GLM5.3 and DeepSeek are now frontier Aikido Security。该消息由Aikido Security发布，主题为“We burned 11.7bn tokens to find the best cyber AI model | GLM5.3 and DeepSeek are now frontier”。其重要性主要体现在：通过消耗大量Token评测网络安全AI模型，为大模型能力边界提供了有价值的基准测试参考。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
